name: atlas
description: Adds /atlas: a file explorer in a pane beside Claude Code, with git marks, search by name or text, and micro to edit a file.

editor.title: Editor for files, e.g. micro, nano, vim, hx
editor.description: Any terminal editor: a name on PATH or a full path such as /opt/homebrew/bin/hx. micro is the default and the friendliest.

python.title: Python 3.9+ to run it, e.g. python3
python.description: The python3 that hosts the editor, a name on PATH or a full path such as /opt/homebrew/bin/python3. Only change this if python3 is missing or older than 3.9.
